description: This file defines the AccountController class with methods for user account management, including registration, login, verification, password reset, logout, and basic auth checks, in an Express.js application.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: Controller class handling account-related HTTP requests such as registration, login, verification, password management, and logout.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration by invoking AccountService.register with request body.

methods.name: invite
methods.description: Handles user invitation by invoking AccountService.invite with request body and user.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login by invoking AccountService.login with request body.

methods.name: forgotPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process via AccountService.forgotPassword.

methods.name: createStripeCustomerPortalSession
methods.description: Creates a Stripe customer portal session and returns the URL.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clears cookies, and destroys session or redirects based on authentication method.

methods.name: getBasicAuth
methods.description: Checks if username and password are set in environment variables and responds accordingly.

methods.name: checkBasicAuth
methods.description: Validates provided username and password against environment variables.
